capabilities: robotics simulation and human-confirmed physical operations
habit tracking and referral preparation; no diagnosis or replacement for licensed care
policy comparison and research support; no unauthorized legal practice or final legal advice

occupational_venture_guide_contract.software_discovery_policy: Discover category leaders, open-source alternatives, local/offline tools and current releases. Named products are examples, not endorsements; verify pricing, licensing, security and availability.
occupational_venture_guide_contract.competence_policy: A written playbook is not a credential, license, proof of competence, or permission to perform regulated work.

source_families.boundary: bounded discovery and individual rights review

source_families.scope: interactive certifications, curriculum chapters, modules, blocks, challenges, projects, articles, videos and open-source platform code
source_families.boundary: curriculum metadata is not permission to copy transcripts or redistribute course content

source_families.scope: occupations, tasks, skills, knowledge, abilities, work activities, tools and technology
source_families.boundary: preserve official data license and version

source_families.scope: language, framework, cloud, security, database, standards and vendor documentation
source_families.boundary: retain source links and documentation reuse terms

source_families.scope: source code, examples, tests, issue histories, architecture and releases
source_families.boundary: review code, dependency, dataset and model licenses separately

source_families.scope: papers, books, theses, preprints, replication packages and scholarly data
source_families.boundary: citation and rights review; do not treat abstract as full-paper study

source_families.scope: laws, regulations, procurement, grants, public budgets, open datasets and agency guidance
source_families.boundary: official current notice controls eligibility and compliance

source_families.scope: professional bodies, standards, competency frameworks and certification objectives
source_families.boundary: standards text may be copyrighted; use authorized access and original explanation

source_families.scope: case studies, forums, postmortems, practical discussions and practitioner experience

governance.training: only explicit asset-level permission, approved manifest, baseline, private holdout, compute approval, checkpoint and rollback
governance.sensitive_decisions: human review and qualified professionals required

teacher.role: ChatGPT/GPT-6 acts as the instructor, curriculum designer, explainer, questioner and evaluator during authorized Buddy learning sessions
duties: compare independent sources and identify disagreements
teacher.boundary: Teacher explanations are not source evidence; important factual claims must retain citations and source revisions.

student.role: Buddy is the student and must demonstrate learning through observable work
duties: teach back the subject to another learner

instructional_model.no_shortcuts: Reading, summarizing, watching a video, or receiving an explanation does not count as mastery without completed practice and independent assessment.

academic_structure.model: college-style departments, prerequisite courses, labs, electives, research seminars and capstones

academic_structure.credentials_policy: DreamCo may issue internal completion records and skill badges after verified assessment. Do not describe them as accredited college degrees, professional licenses or third-party certifications unless formally authorized.
academic_structure.benchmarking: Compare curriculum coverage, depth, assessment rigor, practical projects, accessibility, current tooling and learner outcomes against reputable university open courseware, professional certifications, official documentation and open-source curricula. Publish gaps and evidence; do not claim world-leading equivalence without independent comparison.

hugging_face_coverage.task_taxonomy: Refresh model, dataset and Space tags from official Hub APIs where supported; merge live tags with seed taxonomy and discovered subjects from model cards, dataset cards, Space metadata, papers and repositories.
hugging_face_coverage.subject_policy: Every new subject gets a versioned record, source examples, confidence, division route suggestions and an unclassified review queue if no confident match exists.
hugging_face_coverage.inventory_policy: Enumerate Hub repositories with pagination and bounded per-query budgets; report cursor completion, API failures, rate limits, duplicate IDs, artifact types, total discovered and guides completed separately.
guide_policy: dataset provenance, features, splits and bias
Space user flow, code and dependencies
hugging_face_coverage.training_gate: A public Hub artifact is not automatically approved for training; verify its model, dataset, code and underlying media licenses and terms separately.

scope: legacy curricula as separately versioned references
freecodecamp_coverage.video_inventory: Maintain one canonical record per unique official public video ID. Refresh playlists and channel pages, paginate all available results, deduplicate IDs and publish observed totals, missing IDs and catalog-vs-source reconciliation.
freecodecamp_coverage.summary_requirement: Create a detailed independently authored guide for each source only when the source content and derivative summary are authorized; do not infer lesson content from titles or metadata.
freecodecamp_coverage.assessment_requirement: Weekly test Buddy against every source for which evaluation permission is recorded; retain model version, source revision, test ID, result, evidence hash, score and remediation.
freecodecamp_coverage.rights: The public presence of a video or transcript does not grant transcript scraping, derivative-summary storage, model evaluation, model-weight training or redistribution rights.

division_study_path_standard.shared_core: All 55 canonical domain divisions receive shared foundation lessons and diagnostics; specialist lessons are routed only where evidence supports relevance.
division_study_path_standard.weekly: Review each eligible source at least once weekly, retest failed skills and assess retention and cross-domain transfer.
division_study_path_standard.mastery: Repeated independent performance, unseen transfer, a practical artifact or capstone, delayed retention and no critical safety or rights failures. Reading or summary completion alone is not mastery.

compare_against: freeCodeCamp official curricula and learning resources
Hugging Face task and model documentation
university open courseware and open textbooks
official vendor academies and technical documentation
maintained open-source repositories and reproducible projects
quality_benchmarks.rule: Publish measurable comparisons and gaps. Do not claim to outperform or equal every global training program without independent benchmark evidence.

world_class_benchmark_framework.purpose: Measure DreamCo curriculum depth and outcomes against credible external education, certification, documentation and practical skill standards; publish gaps rather than claiming superiority without evidence.
comparison_sets: professional certification blueprints and vendor academies
official technical documentation and reference architectures
open-source project issue histories, tests and contributor workflows
occupation competency frameworks and verified job task descriptions
research benchmarks, evaluation suites and reproducible challenge sets

dimensions.measure: Prerequisite and topic coverage against at least three independent references
Correct principles, assumptions, derivations, limitations and trade-offs
Guided, independent and advanced exercises with working feedback
Reliable scoring, unseen questions, calibration and held-out transfer
Realistic projects with objective acceptance tests and review
Current professional software, APIs, workflows, open-source and local alternatives
Traceable mapping to O*NET tasks and current professional practice
Revision tracking, broken-link checks and dated source refresh
Privacy, security, licensing, human oversight and professional boundaries
Accessible formats, plain-language explanations and varied learning modes
Spaced retrieval, delayed retest and performance on new tasks

world_class_benchmark_framework.claim_policy: Do not claim world-leading, accredited, equivalent or superior outcomes until independent external comparison and outcome evidence support the claim.

intake_steps: verify source authority, revision and license
create original summary work order only when permissions permit
add to course catalog after review
measure assessment coverage and schedule update
knowledge_expansion_protocol.no_coverage_shortcut: A new topic remains visible in the global subject registry even if it has no division owner or no authorized source. It is never silently discarded or marked covered.

parallel_learning_policy.division_coverage: All 55 domain divisions may begin diagnostics, shared foundations, rights-cleared study and assessment in parallel.
parallel_learning_policy.runtime_concurrency: Schedule up to all eligible divisions concurrently when actual worker capacity, source rights, evaluator availability and budget allow; otherwise use a fair priority queue without starving divisions.
parallel_learning_policy.model_weight_training: Separate per-MasterBot queue. Zero jobs start until each asset has explicit training permission, privacy review, approved dataset manifest, compute allocation, baseline/holdout plan and rollback checkpoint.
parallel_learning_policy.shared_foundations: Teach shared-core material once as an owned course package and assign the same versioned asset to all 55 divisions; track each division's independent attempts and evidence separately.
parallel_learning_policy.resource_safety: Never equate a 55-lane logical schedule with 55 available GPUs or continuous 100-percent utilization. Respect CPU/GPU memory, rate limits, compute budgets and daily caps.
parallel_learning_policy.fairness: Use prerequisites, measured capability gaps, recency, expected learning gain and aging queue time; reserve rotation slots for every division.
